description: When a spec file under .kiro/specs/ is saved, re-check the spec trio for internal consistency: every task references existing requirement numbers, every requirement uses EARS phrasing, and design components named in design.md appear in tasks.md. Report inconsistencies; do not silently rewrite the spec.
name: Verify spec consistency on save

then.prompt: A Boltseam spec file was just saved. Re-read the full spec trio (requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md) for that feature and check: (1) every task's _Requirements:_ line references requirement numbers that exist in requirements.md; (2) every acceptance criterion uses EARS phrasing (THE SYSTEM SHALL, WHEN/IF/WHILE/WHERE patterns); (3) components named in design.md are covered by at least one task; (4) no requirement promises behaviour that the product steering forbids (no monitoring over time, no wallets or prediction markets, no single truth score, no model-decided verdicts). List any inconsistency with file and line references. Do not edit the spec files yourself; report only.
